'''2012 European Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 2012, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> Xerox sheets from the tournament-decklists PDF are listed below as those scans are transcribed. [[Emil Wallin]] is the published European Champion.<ref name="winners">https://www.starwarsccg.org/major-event-winners/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' —
* '''Dates:''' 2012
* '''Winner:''' [[Emil Wallin]]
